name: Correlation Flip Event Study: Gold, Dollar & VIX After SPY/TLT Regime Change (Era Comparison)
description: Detects when the 60-day rolling Pearson correlation between SPY and TLT crosses from negative to positive (stock-bond diversification breaks down), then measures how Gold (GC futures), the US Dollar (UUP), and the VIX behave over the next 20 trading days. Includes era comparison: Taper Tantrum (2013–2014) vs Post-2021 (2022+) vs Other. Outputs: summary table with event count, avg 20d forward returns/changes, hit rates, and avg max drawdown per asset; era comparison bar chart for Gold +20d returns; era comparison summary table with event count, Gold avg return, Gold hit rate, VIX avg level, VIX avg +20d change; rolling correlation line chart with event markers; cumulative event-day returns for Gold & Dollar; cumulative VIX event-day change chart; event markers.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORRELATION FLIP EVENT STUDY: GOLD & DOLLAR AFTER SPY/TLT REGIME CHANGE
# =============================================================================
# Event: 60-day rolling Pearson correlation between SPY & TLT crosses above 0
#        (stocks and bonds stop diversifying each other)
# Reaction assets: Gold (GC futures), US Dollar (UUP as DXY proxy)
# Forward window: 20 trading days
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
spy_src = market_data_source()()
close_spy = spy_src.c

tlt_src = reference_stocks(ticker='TLT')()
close_tlt = tlt_src.c

# Gold via GC futures continuation (backward panama canal for clean series)
gc_ref = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(gc_ref.o, gc_ref.h, gc_ref.l, gc_ref.c, gc_ref.v, gc_ref.oi, gc_ref.s)
close_gc = gc_cont.c

# Dollar Index proxy (UUP ETF)
uup_src = reference_stocks(ticker='UUP')()
close_uup = uup_src.c

# VIX Index
vix_src = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()
close_vix = vix_src.c

idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CORRELATION & FLIP DETECTION
# =============================================================================

# Daily returns for correlation
ret_spy = returns(period=1)(close_spy)
ret_tlt = returns(period=1)(close_tlt)

# 60-day rolling Pearson correlation
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_spy, y=ret_tlt)

# Detect flip: correlation crosses from negative to positive
is_flip = crossover(corr_60d, 0)

# Event counter for summary
flip_count = 1.0 if is_flip else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS (20d) FOR GOLD AND DOLLAR
# =============================================================================

# Post-20d cumulative return from event day close
gc_post20 = ((close_gc << 20) - close_gc) / close_gc
uup_post20 = ((close_uup << 20) - close_uup) / close_uup

# Filter to flip events only
gc_post20_flip = where(is_flip, gc_post20)
uup_post20_flip = where(is_flip, uup_post20)

# Hit rate: was Gold positive after 20d?
gc_hit = where(is_flip, 1.0 if gc_post20 > 0 else 0.0)
uup_hit = where(is_flip, 1.0 if uup_post20 > 0 else 0.0)

# Max drawdown proxy over 20d window: worst forward return at key checkpoints
# Check returns at days 1, 5, 10, 15, 20 and take the minimum
gc_fwd1 = ((close_gc << 1) - close_gc) / close_gc
gc_fwd5 = ((close_gc << 5) - close_gc) / close_gc
gc_fwd10 = ((close_gc << 10) - close_gc) / close_gc
gc_fwd15 = ((close_gc << 15) - close_gc) / close_gc

uup_fwd1 = ((close_uup << 1) - close_uup) / close_uup
uup_fwd5 = ((close_uup << 5) - close_uup) / close_uup
uup_fwd10 = ((close_uup << 10) - close_uup) / close_uup
uup_fwd15 = ((close_uup << 15) - close_uup) / close_uup

# Worst checkpoint return as max drawdown proxy (per event)
gc_min_fwd = conditional_select(
    gc_fwd1 < gc_fwd5 and gc_fwd1 < gc_fwd10 and gc_fwd1 < gc_fwd15 and gc_fwd1 < gc_post20, gc_fwd1,
    gc_fwd5 < gc_fwd10 and gc_fwd5 < gc_fwd15 and gc_fwd5 < gc_post20, gc_fwd5,
    gc_fwd10 < gc_fwd15 and gc_fwd10 < gc_post20, gc_fwd10,
    gc_fwd15 < gc_post20, gc_fwd15,
    gc_post20
)
gc_mdd_flip = where(is_flip, gc_min_fwd if gc_min_fwd < 0 else 0.0)

uup_min_fwd = conditional_select(
    uup_fwd1 < uup_fwd5 and uup_fwd1 < uup_fwd10 and uup_fwd1 < uup_fwd15 and uup_fwd1 < uup_post20, uup_fwd1,
    uup_fwd5 < uup_fwd10 and uup_fwd5 < uup_fwd15 and uup_fwd5 < uup_post20, uup_fwd5,
    uup_fwd10 < uup_fwd15 and uup_fwd10 < uup_post20, uup_fwd10,
    uup_fwd15 < uup_post20, uup_fwd15,
    uup_post20
)
uup_mdd_flip = where(is_flip, uup_min_fwd if uup_min_fwd < 0 else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# VIX: LEVEL AT FLIP & FORWARD CHANGE (+20d)
# =============================================================================

# VIX level on the event day
vix_at_flip = where(is_flip, close_vix)

# VIX absolute change over +20d (not return — VIX is an index level)
vix_change_20d = (close_vix << 20) - close_vix
vix_change_20d_flip = where(is_flip, vix_change_20d)

# Hit rate: did VIX fall over 20d? (positive for risk assets)
vix_fell_hit = where(is_flip, 1.0 if vix_change_20d < 0 else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# ERA CLASSIFICATION: Taper Tantrum (2013-2014), Post-2021 (2022+), Other
# =============================================================================

yr = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(idx)

is_taper = (yr >= 2013) and (yr <= 2014)
is_post21 = yr >= 2022
# "Other" = everything else (2006-2012, 2015-2021)
is_other_era = (is_taper == False) and (is_post21 == False)

# --- Gold +20d return by era (filtered to flip events only) ---
gc_post20_taper = where(is_flip and is_taper, gc_post20)
gc_post20_post21 = where(is_flip and is_post21, gc_post20)
gc_post20_other = where(is_flip and is_other_era, gc_post20)

# --- Gold hit rate by era ---
gc_hit_taper = where(is_flip and is_taper, 1.0 if gc_post20 > 0 else 0.0)
gc_hit_post21 = where(is_flip and is_post21, 1.0 if gc_post20 > 0 else 0.0)
gc_hit_other = where(is_flip and is_other_era, 1.0 if gc_post20 > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Dollar +20d return by era ---
uup_post20_taper = where(is_flip and is_taper, uup_post20)
uup_post20_post21 = where(is_flip and is_post21, uup_post20)
uup_post20_other = where(is_flip and is_other_era, uup_post20)

# --- VIX level at flip by era ---
vix_at_taper = where(is_flip and is_taper, close_vix)
vix_at_post21 = where(is_flip and is_post21, close_vix)
vix_at_other = where(is_flip and is_other_era, close_vix)

# --- VIX +20d change by era ---
vix_chg_taper = where(is_flip and is_taper, vix_change_20d)
vix_chg_post21 = where(is_flip and is_post21, vix_change_20d)
vix_chg_other = where(is_flip and is_other_era, vix_change_20d)

# --- Event count by era ---
flip_taper = where(is_flip and is_taper, 1.0)
flip_post21 = where(is_flip and is_post21, 1.0)
flip_other = where(is_flip and is_other_era, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE EVENT RETURNS (running sum of event-day returns)
# =============================================================================

# Gold day-of return on flip days (0 on non-flip days)
gc_day_ret = returns(period=1)(close_gc)
gc_event_ret = gc_day_ret if is_flip else 0.0
gc_event_ret_clean = gc_event_ret if is_valid(gc_event_ret) else 0.0
cum_gc = cumulative()(gc_event_ret_clean)

# Dollar day-of return on flip days
uup_day_ret = returns(period=1)(close_uup)
uup_event_ret = uup_day_ret if is_flip else 0.0
uup_event_ret_clean = uup_event_ret if is_valid(uup_event_ret) else 0.0
cum_uup = cumulative()(uup_event_ret_clean)

# VIX day-of change on flip days (absolute change, not return)
vix_day_change = close_vix - (close_vix >> 1)
vix_event_change = vix_day_change if is_flip else 0.0
vix_event_change_clean = vix_event_change if is_valid(vix_event_change) else 0.0
cum_vix = cumulative()(vix_event_change_clean)

# Correlation value at flip for event markers
corr_at_flip = where(is_flip, corr_60d)

# =============================================================================
# CORRELATION CHART: split into positive/negative for area fill
# =============================================================================
corr_positive = where(corr_60d >= 0, corr_60d)
corr_negative = where(corr_60d < 0, corr_60d)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: event stats ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Correlation Flip Impact (Neg→Pos)',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Gold (GC)', 'Dollar (UUP)', 'VIX'],
        col_headers=['Avg +20d Return / Level', 'Hit Rate (% Positive / Fell)', 'Avg Max DD / +20d Chg', 'Event Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Gray),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Gray),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Amber),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Amber)
        ]
    ),
    category='Correlation Flip Study',
    order=0
)(gc_post20_flip, gc_hit, gc_mdd_flip, flip_count, uup_post20_flip, uup_hit, uup_mdd_flip, flip_count, vix_at_flip, vix_fell_hit, vix_change_20d_flip, flip_count)

# --- Chart 1: Rolling 60d SPY/TLT Correlation with Flip Events ---
xy_lines(
    title='SPY/TLT 60d Rolling Correlation: When Diversification Breaks Down',
    category='Correlation Flip Study',
    y_axis_label='Rolling 60d Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Moving Together', color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Diversifying', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=1
)(idx, corr_positive, corr_negative)

# --- Chart 2: Cumulative Gold & Dollar Event-Day Returns ---
xy_lines(
    title='Gold & Dollar: Cumulative Returns Harvested on Correlation Flip Days',
    category='Correlation Flip Study',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Gold (GC)', color=Color.Gold),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Dollar (UUP)', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=2
)(idx, cum_gc, cum_uup)

# --- Chart 3: Cumulative VIX Event-Day Change ---
xy_lines(
    title='VIX: Cumulative Change Harvested on Correlation Flip Days',
    category='Correlation Flip Study',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative VIX Change (pts)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VIX Cum. Change', color=Color.Amber)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Neutral')
    ]),
    order=3
)(idx, cum_vix)

# --- Event Markers: Correlation Flip Events ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Correlation Flip (Neg→Pos)',
        icon=Icon.ShuffleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Correlation', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Gold +20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Dollar +20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='VIX Level', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='VIX +20d Change', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_flip, corr_at_flip, gc_post20_flip, uup_post20_flip, vix_at_flip, vix_change_20d_flip)

# --- Chart 4: Gold +20d Avg Return by Era (Grouped Bar Chart) ---
xy_bars(
    title='Gold +20d Avg Return After Correlation Flip by Era',
    category='Correlation Flip Study',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg +20d Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Taper Tantrum (2013-14)', color=Color.Gold),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Post-2021 (2022+)', color=Color.Amber),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Other', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=4
)(values=(gc_post20_taper, gc_post20_post21, gc_post20_other))

# --- Era Comparison Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Era Comparison: Correlation Flip Response',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Taper Tantrum (2013-14)', 'Post-2021 (2022+)', 'Other'],
        col_headers=['Event Count', 'Gold Avg +20d Ret', 'Gold Hit Rate', 'VIX Avg Level', 'VIX Avg +20d Chg'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Gold),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Gold),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Amber),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Amber),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Correlation Flip Study',
    order=5
)(flip_taper, gc_post20_taper, gc_hit_taper, vix_at_taper, vix_chg_taper, flip_post21, gc_post20_post21, gc_hit_post21, vix_at_post21, vix_chg_post21, flip_other, gc_post20_other, gc_hit_other, vix_at_other, vix_chg_other)
